name: LogicBench
description: Recently developed large language models (LLMs) have been shown to perform remarkably well on a wide range of language understanding tasks. But, can they really "reason" over the natural language? This question has been receiving significant research attention and many reasoning skills such as commonsense, numerical, and qualitative have been studied.
reputation: A recent reasoning benchmark that has gained attention for probing whether LLMs can perform structured natural-language reasoning beyond surface pattern matching.
notes: Likely includes diverse reasoning subskills and may be susceptible to benchmark contamination as a recent LLM-focused benchmark.
